paras: Dring's rock gecko (Cnemaspis dringi), also known commonly as Dring's Borneo rock gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Borneo.
The specific name, dringi, is in honor of British herpetologist Julian Christopher Mark Dring (born 1951).
The preferred natural habitat of C. dringi is forest, at altitudes of 30–800 m (98–2,625 ft).
C. dringi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 4.5 cm (1.8 in). It has dark flanks with whitish spots.
